def count_growable_land(x, y, heights):
    # Create a 2D list to store the maximum water level that can be trapped in each cell
    water_trap = [[0] * x for _ in range(y)]

    # Fill the borders with the maximum possible height (999)
    for i in range(y):
        water_trap[i][0] = 999
        water_trap[i][x - 1] = 999
    for j in range(x):
        water_trap[0][j] = 999
        water_trap[y - 1][j] = 999

    # Process the inner cells
    for i in range(1, y - 1):
        for j in range(1, x - 1):
            # The water level in this cell is determined by the minimum of the max water levels
            # of its adjacent cells minus its own height
            water_trap[i][j] = min(water_trap[i - 1][j], water_trap[i + 1][j],
                                   water_trap[i][j - 1], water_trap[i][j + 1]) - heights[i][j]
            # Ensure the water level is not negative
            water_trap[i][j] = max(water_trap[i][j], 0)

    # Calculate the total area that can grow rice
    total_growable_area = sum(sum(water_trap[i]) for i in range(y))
    return total_growable_area
